description: Governance specification for YT6 evaluation system: rule hierarchy, override logic, lifecycle control, and auditability.

hierarchy.description: Defines the strict ordering of evaluation rules. Higher levels override lower levels.

override_logic.description: Ensures rule conflicts resolve upward, never downward.

initialization.description: Load engine, grader, schema, metadata, profile.

preflight.description: Run hashing, security, determinism, and compliance checks.

execution.description: Run evaluation with mode-lock and zero-variance guarantees.

postflight.description: Run invariance, equivalence, consistency, stability, drift, variance, and replay checks.

finalization.description: Generate manifest, fingerprint, audit log, and governance report.
